title: Au Bonheur Des Dames
identity: Jean Matitia, Au bonheur des dames for alto saxophone and piano, Henry Lemoine 27975. The Lemoine 2024 saxophone catalog gives level 3 and 16 pages; the FFEA lists the work in its 2022 cycle III CEM collection.

evidence.claim: Catalog entry identifies the Lemoine edition and saxophone/piano scoring.
Henry Lemoine’s current saxophone catalog lists Au bonheur des dames for alto saxophone and piano, catalog 27975, level 3, 16 pages.
FFEA’s 2022 collection of alto saxophone works includes this title in its cycle III CEM section.
Adolphesax page identifies a live performance by Richard Ducros, alto saxophone, and Sophie Teboul, piano, at Gradignan.

collection_flag: Publisher lists level 3 and a French federation’s 2022 cycle III CEM collection includes the title. This is contextual evidence and does not set a SaxoBrain level.

listening.description: Richard Ducros, alto saxophone, and Sophie Teboul, piano, live in Gradignan.
listening.verification: Performance video listing identified; playback not auditioned.
